name: Beef Lasagne

ingredients.name: instant lasagne sheets
ingredients.original: 250 g dried instant lasagne sheets (about 9 sheets)

steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C. Heat a splash of olive oil in a large deep frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the brown onion for 3-4 minutes until soft, then add the garlic and cook for 1 minute more.
Add the beef mince and cook for 5-6 minutes, breaking it up with a wooden spoon, until browned all over.

Stir in the tomato paste and dried Italian herbs and cook for 1 minute. Pour in the passata and beef stock, season with salt and pepper, and simmer uncovered for 15 minutes. Keep the sauce loose rather than thick - the lasagne sheets soak up the liquid as they bake.
Spread a thin layer of sauce over the base of a roughly 20 x 30 cm baking dish so the pasta doesn't stick.

Build the layers: a layer of instant lasagne sheets, a third of the remaining sauce, then a scatter of shredded mozzarella. Repeat twice more so you finish with sauce on top, making sure the top sheets are fully covered.
Scatter the remaining shredded mozzarella and all the parmesan over the top.
Cover the dish with foil and bake for 30 minutes, then remove the foil and bake for another 10-15 minutes until the cheese is golden and the pasta is tender when pierced with a knife.
Rest the lasagne for 10 minutes before slicing so the layers hold together, then serve.
